English: Open Market Blanket
A humble piece of cloth spread on the ground, where basic goods are exchanged among travelers and nomads. The first step toward a true trading community.
Barter Stall
A simple wooden stall, protected by a patchwork tarp, where goods and livestock are bartered. Improves local commerce and unity.
Covered Goods Stand
A more permanent, canvas-roofed stand for displaying wares. Attracts more traders, increasing prosperity and supporting a growing horde.
Pack Animal Station
A gathering point for beasts of burden, where traders and caravans can rest and resupply before continuing their journey.
Merchants Tent
A well-furnished, guarded tent where prominent merchants strike lucrative deals and host influential guests from afar.
Exchange Pavilion
A large, sturdy pavilion where distant traders meet, and the first attempts at standardized trade practices are employed.
Trading Post
A semi-permanent structure of timber and hide, this post serves as a hub for regional trade and information exchange, drawing merchants from neighboring lands.
Travelers' Market
A bustling, multi-tent market that draws traders and wanderers from many realms. Diverse wares, news, and folk mingle freely, fueling the hordes prosperity.
Grand Caravan Bazaar
A sprawling bazaar, with permanent yurts and pavilions, where entire caravans converge. Exotic luxuries and rare beasts are traded in grand style, and the hordes influence swells.
Silk Road Emporium
A legendary emporium at the crossroads of the world, with palatial tents, stone storehouses, and a river of goods from East and West. The hordes renown, wealth, and unity reach unprecedented heights.
